forecast_gate.high_error_rule: position>0.05m or carried>50kg or pile-MAE>0.01m or reward>0.05 or terminal mismatch
forecast_gate.selection_rule: highest validation coverage with >=20 accepted rows and <=10% high-error rate; then measured drift limits
forecast_gate.uncertainty_method: RMS ensemble standard deviation of train-normalised residual/reward outputs

validation_drift.diagnostic_mode: fixed recorded actions; do not stop on predicted events; never cross reference boundaries
fixed recorded actions; do not stop on predicted events; never cross reference boundaries

admission.scope: conditional synthetic qualification; no field admission
